title: Kể: telling the story of your day

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say fifteen —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: mười lăm] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say twenty-one —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hai mươi mốt] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say four, at the end of a number —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tư] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say one hundred —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: một trăm] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say to invite —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: mời] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say birthday —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sinh nhật] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Kể đi!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, đầu tiên tôi ăn sáng, sau đó tôi làm việc, cuối cùng tôi về nhà.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Vui quá hả?] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Today,] [VI: kể] [EN: means to tell, or to narrate. It has] [VI: dấu hỏi] [EN: . Listen again.] [VI_F: kể] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: kể] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: kể] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Use it to ask someone to tell you something —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Kể đi!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: And to say you'll tell your own story —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi kể nha.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now build a whole story with it — first I went to the park, then I met friends, finally I came home —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi kể nha. [EN: Quick pass over today's word.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To tell, or narrate —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: kể] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill. To tell, or narrate —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: kể] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now build it. Tell me! —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Kể đi!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: I'll tell you — first I went to the park, then I met friends, finally I came home —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi kể nha.
